detail: the water-carrier Ruxa-Neel and the sap-seller Wujeel speak of it
the healer Taleeka-Ma heals and sells spell tomes there, and she and the sap-seller Wujeel both name it and its leader
she is seen clearing creepers from tree roots
the healers' leader calls her the root-tender at the door; the elder Hixee-Ra speaks first and says who she is
Cheeval-Xu, spoken to, offers to call a rootworm to carry the player to other towns
